firstOpenAfterIdle.note: Janko layout (the owner's), a fresh writable copy of the private data copy for each run, each score opened in library order with Back in between. "At once": opened as soon as the library showed. "After idle": the library was left alone until no score was being prepared and no line showed for 6 s (35 s; 5 scores worked on, 5 with a line), so its background work (viewer PRs 214, 216, 217) had run. The simulated host starts with an empty derived-file store. Measured on a shared, loaded build host.

browserInspection.limits: Headless Chromium with a simulated native host, not WebView2 or WKWebView, not an installed package. Physical MIDI, audio, practice at a keyboard and the pianist's musical acceptance were not observed. A key pressed while the opening dialog still shows its progress can be ignored by design; none is lost once the score is drawn.
